page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key characteristic of the ecs.i4.2xlarge is its integrated local storage, which consists of a 1919 GB SSD. This bundled storage capacity is designed for high-throughput local data access. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates without relying on complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores, a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and a large local SSD makes this instance a resource-dense option for I/O-intensive workloads. It is well-suited for relational databases, NoSQL databases, caching layers, and medium-scale data processing tasks that require low-latency local storage and substantial memory capacity.
